name: Supericons
description: Supericons helps Claude find the right SVG icon by meaning, not just by file name. It can search 20,000+ free icons, recommend coherent icon sets for app navigation and dashboards, retrieve exact SVG code, and list supported icon libraries.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Supericons to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Supericons to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.supericons.dev/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Supericons MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Supericons provides these MCP tools: search_icons, recommend_icons, get_icon, and list_libraries.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Supericons?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Supericons in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Supericons does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Supericons is developed by Curly Mole Labs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
